designationHistory.indexText: Established in 1955 under the Migratory Bird Conservation Act, when the Migratory Bird Conservation Commission approved purchase of the first 1,440 acres.

authority.citation: Migratory Bird Conservation Act, 16 U.S.C. 715d; Migratory Bird Conservation Commission approval, fiscal year 1955

designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Quivira National Wildlife Refuge, About Us
FWS news release, June 14, 1955: in fiscal year 1955 the Migratory Bird Conservation Commission approved purchase of 1,440 acres "to form the initial tract of the Quivira National Wildlife Refuge"

review.note: Draft year 1956 was parsed from the "Fish and Wildlife Act of 1956" in a list of authorities. MBCC approved the new refuge in fiscal year 1955 (FWS release of June 14, 1955). Confirm against the refuge CCP if a day is needed.

designationHistory.indexOriginal: Quivira Refuge was established under these authorities and for these purposes: Migratory Bird Conservation Act (16 United States Code [U.S.C.] § 715d) for use as an inviolate sanctuary, or for any other management purpose, for migratory birds Fish and Wildlife Act of 1956 (16 U.S.C. § 742f(a)4) or the development, advancement, management, conservation, and protection of fish and wildlife resources

historySource: Refuge About Us pages, fws.gov (draft, pending review)
